entry: Pin accepted design and source state at B00; no implementation approval is recorded in this candidate
progression: Each predecessor needs actual scoped acceptance/recovery evidence and a validated local commit. Independent bundles may progress once their prerequisites are satisfied and ownership is isolated.

bundles.title: Pin accepted design and baseline
acceptance: Record explicit design acceptance and build go. Pin exact final docs, procedure and role matrices, examples, DAG, base commit and interpreter.
Verify baseline and scoped existing receipts. Record data availability. Preserve unrelated index and worktree state.
recovery: If a pin or base differs, diagnose to the source before starting. No repin or automatic baseline reset.

bundles.title: Bounded wire, exact values and typed references
acceptance: Implement exact S4 wire version and role grammar; round-trip all worked packages with golden canonical bytes.
Check strict JSON, duplicate fields and keys, numeric reduction, over-limit input and every cap boundary. Check wrong contracts, bad selectors, dangling targets, proof cycles and self-digests.
recovery: Malformed or exhausted input produces a bounded scoped diagnostic. Preserve original bytes, and distinguish unresolved references from structural failures.

bundles.title: Bindings, plans and scoped premises
acceptance: Materialize exact S1/S2/S3 roles under explicit read access. Verify scoped inputs, pinned registry/config and output-role maps. Exercise structural pass with applicability hold.
Check denied reference, scope-local versus global conflict, changed frontier, incompatible quantities and role-specific requirements. Plan and inspect exercise no scientific work or writes.
recovery: Missing required input holds only the affected scope. Reopening a locator with changed bytes must not substitute the old pinned input.

bundles.title: Calculation lifecycle and durable work evidence
acceptance: Pure evaluator boundary, admitted invocation and distinct observed occurrence. Validate emitted roles, partial extent and separate commit/claim steps.
Controlled fixtures demonstrate local deterministic results, failed work with zero emissions and a role-specific hold beside a defined output.
recovery: Inject loss before and after observed start and record commit. Reconcile exact transaction, reject same ID/different basis, prove recording never reexecutes, and preserve unknown where lookup is unavailable.

bundles.title: Q01 proposition judgment
acceptance: Qualify graph adjacency and local parent-membership readers using independent finite truth-ledger oracles. Check covered and full masks, closure, explicit abstention, trustworthy partial answers, and reference policy closure.
Check graph 2/2 with full held, changed binding 2/3, local 1/1, scoped 0/3 with undefined ratio and missing answer with preflight hold.
recovery: Recover from truncated or revised stream and lost bytes without fabricating decisions. A recovered source creates an updated binding and preserves old results.

bundles.title: Q02 strict sequence and Q03 binary loss
acceptance: Enumerate the six small permutations independently. Separate fulfillment, violations and admissibility for complete and necessary-only reference conditions.
Verify exact 1/25 loss, endpoints and complement symmetry. Reject wrong event, wrong outcome and p-value semantics. Qualify prospective issuance order against the named access policy.
recovery: Truncated order or unresolved timing holds the appropriate role. A later verified receipt can create a new binding while preserving the earlier frontier.

bundles.title: Q04 paired point and Q05 utility enclosure
acceptance: Require n exact intended pairs, two arms and 2n slots. Independently verify paired differences and enclosure arithmetic, including all singleton ranges and coupled feasibility.

Check named frame, attempts, horizon, first qualifying selection, before-failure delivery, incomplete closure, time straddle, unknown winner and ranges. Check 3/20 to 13/20, widened -7/20 to 13/20 and held ordinary quality.
recovery: Capture gaps retain their uncertainty. A late receipt updates the evidence frontier and can narrow a range without dropping slots or changing the horizon.

bundles.title: Q06 finite conditional inference
acceptance: Independent finite joint-mass oracle, named model and observation protocol, exact keyed normalization and conditional P4 assessment. Check duplicate keys, zero prior, missing likelihood and zero normalizer.
Prove zero weights and normalizer may be emitted while posterior is undefined. Hold empirical model-fit and causal claims outside the contract.
recovery: A corrected model or observation uses a new target or binding as applicable. Failed or interrupted work cannot fabricate posterior or model validation.

bundles.title: P5 exact computational reproduction
acceptance: Qualify exact comparator for all initial result families and declared diagnostic cases. Verify same-basis agreement, same-basis derived-mask disagreement, different-basis hold, and score-only versus mask-derivation boundary.
Compare selected roles and exact scope. Require actual new occurrence and original sources. Preserve original and replay outputs independently.
recovery: Original unavailable, denied or wrong bytes holds replay. Incomplete observed replay holds comparison. No silent widening or automatic repeat after uncertain prior work.

bundles.title: S3 carrier, audience closure and publication
acceptance: Register exact typed payload, verify S4/S3 dependency reconciliation and pinned projection. Exercise a restricted full view and authorized narrower public view with no restricted metadata leak.
Verify parser support alone cannot approve claims. Use real local S3 journal, storage lookup and pointer CAS fixtures.
recovery: Inject stage/commit reply loss and pointer conflict. Reconcile without duplicate evaluation or accidental publication, prove authorization at each effect, and retain immutable committed snapshot on pointer failure.

bundles.title: Read-only legacy mapping and preservation
acceptance: Qualify scoped P0/P1 mapping and refusals for legacy tiers, direction variants, completed/delivered, common-key paired and bootstrap, calibration/ranking and certificates.

Run explicitly authorized recorded-data compatibility gate: 1298 comparisons at 0.001, 14 stored and 14 fresh certificate verifications. Keep paper sources, tolerances and legacy route identities pinned.
recovery: Missing historical input yields explicit unavailable coverage. No fallback to fabricated inputs, no repair/rebaseline of historical receipts and no research code imports.

bundles.title: Integrated release evidence and support review
acceptance: Trace each procedure and profile scope to source, fixture, receipt, limits and unsupported cases. Exercise inspect/plan CLI, typed calculation entry and installed-wheel isolation. Run mandatory full staged gate and hook with local commit.
Report offline and historical data gates separately. Preserve actual skips and exact compatibility claims. Release review is a local milestone.
recovery: Exercise clean checkout and recovery/reopen paths. Report unresolved gaps and hold any unproven release claims. Remote publication remains separately authorized.
